welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.login_prompt: Sign in and join the community.

welcome_description: Share various stories in a growing community together.
seo_description: Explore notices, free discussion, and Q&A in a flexible public community starter.
hero_description: A universal starting point for boards, posts, and member discussions in a public community.
hero_footer: Set up boards, invite members, and let new activity fill this page naturally.

smart_cta.new_member_message: Start with the Q&A board so your first post gets the right context.
smart_cta.active_member_message: Return to the board where the conversation is already moving.

community_notice_panel.title: Community Notices
community_notice_panel.description: Use this space for essential updates, operating notes, and first steps.
community_notice_panel.empty_title: Publish a notice when the community opens
community_notice_panel.guidance_1: Share what the community is for and who it welcomes.
community_notice_panel.guidance_2: Explain where members should post questions, ideas, and updates.
community_notice_panel.guidance_3: Keep setup guidance current as boards and policies change.

start_post_title: Choose where to start your post
start_post_description: If you have questions, start with the Q&A board.
start_post_free_description: Share everyday topics and open discussion.
start_post_qna_description: Ask questions and get help from the community.
no_posts: Recent posts will appear here after members begin posting.
recent_posts_empty_description: Recent posts will appear here as soon as members publish topics in any board.
no_boards: Popular boards will appear after community activity begins.
popular_boards_empty_title: Popular boards will be ranked by activity
popular_boards_empty_description: Boards move into this area after they receive posts, visits, and member participation.
featured_boards_description: Highlight useful spaces as the community structure takes shape.
empty_board_description: Create or enable boards first. As posts and visits grow, useful spaces will be highlighted here.
empty_board_setup_description: Prepare the categories or boards that visitors should see first.
empty_board_activity_description: Posting and visits help the template choose which boards deserve attention.

community_hub.title: Community Hub
community_hub.description: Move from the home page into activity, board spaces, and Q&A without losing context.
community_hub.no_recent_activity: New posts will appear here after the first community activity.
community_hub.activity_hint: Use recent activity to find where the community is moving now.
community_hub.qna_description: Use the Q&A board for questions, context, and follow-up details.
community_hub.first_run_description: When the community is new, prepare the first paths visitors should follow.
community_hub.first_run_step_boards: Enable the core boards visitors should see first.
community_hub.first_run_step_seed: Publish a welcome notice and a sample discussion topic.
community_hub.first_run_step_invite: Invite early members to answer questions and start replies.

live_activity.title: Live Activity
live_activity.empty_description: New posts and comment activity will appear here as members participate.

board_discovery.title: Board Discovery
board_discovery.description: Choose the right board before opening a discussion.
board_discovery.purpose_free: Open discussion and everyday community topics.
board_discovery.purpose_introductions: A place for new members to introduce themselves.
board_discovery.purpose_support: Help requests and issues that need community support.
board_discovery.empty_description: Board shortcuts will appear here after boards are created or activity data becomes available.

support_entry.title: Report & Support
support_entry.description: Use these paths when you find problematic content or need the operator to review an issue.
support_entry.report_description: Leave the context and link in the support board so the operator can review it.
support_entry.policy_description: Review reporting, moderation, and community usage rules.

guide_rule_3: Post updates in the right board.
